description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for connection-related events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common properties and methods for events pertaining to connectivity, such as type, connection ID, timestamp, headers, and JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: AbstractConnectivityEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a connectivity-related event with common properties and JSON serialization behavior.

methods.name: AbstractConnectivityEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with type, connection ID, timestamp, and headers, ensuring non-null values where applicable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the connection entity associated with the event.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an optional timestamp of when the event occurred.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, as metadata is not stored in this base class.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as its manifest representation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JSON object, including type, timestamp, connection ID, and custom payload.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Abstract method to append specific payload details to the JSON builder; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on type, connection ID, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper to support proper equality checks in inheritance hierarchies.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash based on the same fields used in equals.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event object.
